notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Filters crt.sh certificate transparency log output to find subdomains matching a specific string (e.g., "dev", "staging", "admin", "api", "vpn"). CT logs record every publicly trusted TLS certificate ever issued — including for decommissioned subdomains still running outdated software.

=== WHY CT LOGS ===
Unlike brute-forcing (bounded by wordlist quality), CT logs are a factual historical record of every certificate issued for a domain. Reveals subdomains with unusual/non-guessable names that no wordlist would find. Expired certificate subdomains may still be live and running unpatched software.

=== CHAINING ===
crtsh-json (get all certs) → jq filter for substring → unique subdomains → resolve to IPs → nmap scan targets.

=== PASSIVE ===
No traffic reaches the target — all queries go to crt.sh API. One of the lowest-risk recon techniques available.
